name: Croatia

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 3874350 inhabitants, recorded as 3.874 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained: the Academy of Arts and Culture in Osijek, part of the public Josip Juraj Strossmayer University. Criteria read at source: a three-year bachelor's degree in Acting and Puppetry awarding the title of baccalaureus of acting and puppetry, registered at level 6 of the Croatian Qualifications Framework; puppetry named in the title; state university programme. The academy also carries master's degrees in puppet animation, design and directing. Counted by establishment: 1. Upper bound at 2: pages not read present Osijek as Croatia's only puppetry school, but that claim was not verified at source and is therefore not used to close the range.
